description_en: Provides a large language model-based intelligent cross-platform product category matching service. Accepts product information from a source platform, automatically matches the best category on the target listing platform, and returns a confidence level score with matching reasons to help merchants quickly select categories during cross-platform product listing. (Synchronization)
description_zh: 基于大语言模型的跨平台商品类目智能匹配服务。输入货源平台的商品信息，自动匹配铺货平台的最佳匹配类目，并返回置信度评分与匹配理由，帮助商家快速完成跨平台铺货时的类目选择。（同步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge category-match --source-platform 1688 --target-platform temu --title '女士春季新款衣服' --description '真丝，春季新款' --source-category '衣服' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CategoryMatch

parameters.help_en: The source platform where products are sourced from
parameters.name: source_platform

parameters.help_en: The target listing platform. Currently only temu is supported
parameters.name: target_platform

parameters.help_en: The product category on the source platform
parameters.name: source_category

parameters.example: 0:0:颜色:黑(不含定位器);0:1:颜色:智能定位(不含项圈);0:2:颜色:范围定位(不含项圈);0:3:颜色:蓝(不含定位器);0:4:颜色:橙(不含定位器);0:5:颜色:粉(不含定位器);0:6:颜色:红(不含定位器);0:7:颜色:黄(不含定位器);0:8:颜色:紫(不含定位器)
parameters.name: sku

parameters.example: 材质:涤纶,适用对象:通用,品牌:艾马逊AMASON PET
parameters.help_en: The product attributes that describe the characteristics of the product, such as material. Provide the attribute names and values
parameters.help_zh: 商品属性，商品的特征描述，例如商品的材质等。输入商品属性名称和属性内容
parameters.name: item_spec

Code.description_en: The status code. The value "success" is returned for successful calls
Code.description_zh: 状态码，正常调用时返回"success"
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

CategoryPath.description_en: The full path of the category, separated by "/"
CategoryPath.example: 宠物用品/猫用品/猫挂饰、项圈、牵引带/位置和活动跟踪器

Confidence.description_en: The matching confidence score, ranging from 0 to 100

MatchSuccessful.description_en: Indicates whether the matching is successful

Reason.description_en: The explanation of the matching reason
Reason.example: 商品核心为带 AirTag 定位功能的猫项圈，属'位置和活动跟踪器'类目，叶子节点语义精准匹配其追踪功能与猫用属性。

Message.description_en: The error message. The value "Success" is returned for successful calls
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
